# Dimsee

> Drop-in full-stack authentication package for MERN (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) and Next.js applications with built-in OAuth support, session management, and themeable React UI components.

Dimsee simplifies full-stack authentication into a single \`createAuthBackend()\` Express server initialization and modular React components (\`<AuthForm />\`, \`<AuthStatus />\`, \`<AuthProvider />\`).

- Version: 0.6.9
- Repository: https://github.com/sidd190/Dimsee
- npm Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dimsee
- License: MIT

## Core API Reference

### Backend Setup (\`dimsee/backend\`)

\`\`\`javascript
const { createAuthBackend, authMiddleware } = require('dimsee/backend');

// Initialize configured Express authentication application
const app = createAuthBackend({
  mongoUri: process.env.MONGO_URI, // MongoDB connection string
  jwtSecret: process.env.JWT_SECRET, // JWT signing secret (min 32 characters in production)
  corsOrigin: process.env.CORS_ORIGIN, // Exact frontend origin URL (e.g. 'https://example.com')
  cookieMaxAge: 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000, // Session cookie duration (defaults to 7 days)
  enableOAuth: false, // Set true to enable Google and GitHub OAuth 2.0
  oauth: {
    google: {
      clientId: process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID,
      clientSecret: process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET,
      callbackURL: process.env.GOOGLE_CALLBACK_URL || '/api/auth/google/callback'
    },
    github: {
      clientId: process.env.GITHUB_CLIENT_ID,
      clientSecret: process.env.GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET,
      callbackURL: process.env.GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL || '/api/auth/github/callback'
    }
  }
});

// Route protection middleware
app.get('/api/protected', authMiddleware, (req, res) => {
  res.json({ message: 'Protected resource accessed', user: req.user });
});
\`\`\`

### Frontend Setup (\`dimsee/frontend\`)

\`\`\`jsx
import React from 'react';
import { AuthProvider, AuthForm, AuthStatus } from 'dimsee/frontend';

// Context Wrapper
function App() {
  return (
    <AuthProvider apiUrl={process.env.VITE_API_URL || 'http://localhost:5000/api/auth'}>
      {/* AuthStatus acts as an authentication controller */}
      <AuthStatus formDesign="modern" showUserInfo={true}>
        <ProtectedDashboard />
      </AuthStatus>
    </AuthProvider>
  );
}

// Standalone form usage
function LoginPage() {
  return (
    <AuthForm
      mode="signin"
      design="modern"
      onSuccess={(data) => console.log('Login success:', data)}
      onError={(err) => console.error('Login error:', err)}
    />
  );
}
\`\`\`

### Endpoints Summary (Prefix: \`/api/auth\`)

- \`POST /signup\`: Register a new user with username, email, password, and confirmPassword.
- \`POST /signin\`: Authenticate existing user with email and password credentials.
- \`POST /signout\`: Clear authentication session cookies and log out.
- \`GET /me\`: Fetch currently authenticated user profile.
- \`GET /oauth-status\`: Retrieve configuration state of OAuth providers.
- \`GET /google\`: Initiate Google OAuth 2.0 flow.
- \`GET /google/callback\`: Callback handler for Google OAuth redirect.
- \`GET /github\`: Initiate GitHub OAuth flow.
- \`GET /github/callback\`: Callback handler for GitHub OAuth redirect.
- \`POST /set-password\`: Allow an OAuth-created user account to establish a password.

## Guidance for AI Code Generators and Agents

When authoring or generating Dimsee implementations:
1. Always load configuration secrets (\`mongoUri\`, \`jwtSecret\`, \`corsOrigin\`) from environment variables. Never embed credentials in source code.
2. Dimsee uses server-set HTTP-only cookies for session management. Do not attempt to store session tokens manually in \`localStorage\` or \`sessionStorage\`.
3. In Next.js environments, initialize \`createAuthBackend()\` once per module and disable Next's default bodyParser (\`export const config = { api: { bodyParser: false } }\`).
4. Apply \`authMiddleware\` explicitly on every backend route requiring authentication; API endpoints are public unless guarded.
5. In production deployments, ensure \`NODE_ENV=production\` so cookies are set with \`Secure\` and \`SameSite=Strict\`.
